title: Turn cross-slice operator requests into tasks or memory at handoff
body:
Outcome: operator requests that span slices never live only in handoff notes or transcripts. At handoff, every open operator request is either a krn task, a memory entry, or explicitly listed as closed.
Evidence: the herdr-tabs request (2026-10-30) lived only in transcript handoff notes; no task or memory existed until the session-continuity handoff.
Inputs: Claude Code remember/memory research verdict (session-continuity outcome); .claude/skills/krn-handoff/SKILL.md step 2.
Proof: krn-handoff gains an executable check (script or `krn state check` rule) that refuses a handoff listing an operator request without a task id or memory pointer.
